# ANALYSIS: Walk-forward OOS and Real-fills Validation Task

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are to execute a walk-forward OOS test from 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 with 12-month training / 3-month testing folds, requiring average WF ratio ≥ 0.70, and validate real-fills on top 3 J-days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) with ≤20% P&L difference vs BS-sim. This test is to validate the engine's performance (baseline or with current ratified candidates) against the OP-16 anchors and real-fills accuracy.

## Mechanism

We would run a backtest engine over the period 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (approx 18 months of available data), splitting into walk-forward folds with 12-month training and 3-month testing periods. For example:
- Fold 1: train 2025-01-02 to 2025-12-31, test 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31
- Fold 2: train 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31, test 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-18 (adjusted for data end)
We compute the WF ratio (OOS/IS P&L per month) for each fold and require the average ≥ 0.70.
Additionally, we validate real-fills on the top 3 J-days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by comparing P&L from BS-simulator to real OPRA simulator (using cached real fills, bid-ask, slippage model), requiring ≤20% difference.
